nodes.title: 2026-10-10 main session, delegated, on the games research's owner questions (docs/research/round4/games/FEASIBILITY.md §6): O-G1 dressed 3D worlds are allowed for 3D engines, scenery never on a learning object, learning objects drawn on top in reserved hues with labels on backing pills, and the child pilot carries a plain-vs-dressed arm (seductive details g -0.33); O-G2 an adaptive music bed is allowed, hard-ducked to 0 within ~120 ms whenever she speaks, OFF by default for classes 4-5 (the child can turn it on), music:off stays in the dress enum; O-G4 the 'daago / fire' verb is used at non-living targets only (mines, asteroids, drones; nothing alive destroyed), with a parent switch to 'scan' wording. Wave 2 runs three sessions: G1 games core + Antariksh, G2 Khand voxel world, U1 gamified app directions for the owner to pick (docs/design/round4/BUILD-PLAN-V2.md). Reverse if: the owner overrides, the pilot's dressed arm learns less on delayed bare items (O-G1), or parents object to the verb (O-G4).
